hints.content:
The area of each smaller rectangle is the product of its height and its width.

Once we find the areas of all the smaller rectangles, we can add them up to get an expression for the entire area.

[[☃ image 1]]

Now let's add all the areas of the smaller rectangles and combine like terms.

options.alt: Six rectangles of different sizes make up a larger rectangle. At the top left, a rectangle has the width of two t and a length of t squared. Inside of this rectangle is two t cubed. At the top right rectangle, it has a width of one with a length of t squared. Inside it is t squared. At the middle left rectangle, it has a width of two t and a length of seven t. Inside it is fourteen t squared. At the middle right rectangle has the width of one and a length of seven t. Inside of this rectangle is seven t. At the bottom left rectangle, it has a width of two t with a length of six. Inside it is twelve t. At the bottom right rectangle, it has a width of one and a length of six. Inside it is six.

question.content:
A rectangle has a height of $t^2+7t+6$ and a width of $2t+1$. 

**Express the area of the entire rectangle.**
